WITH target_account AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
start_balance AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
end_balance AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_account)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((SELECT balance FROM end_balance) - (SELECT balance FROM start_balance)) * 100.0
       / (SELECT balance FROM start_balance) AS increase_rate

WITH approved_loan AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.status = 'A'
      AND l.date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_before AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM approved_loan)
      AND t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_after AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM approved_loan)
      AND t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ((SELECT balance FROM balance_after) - (SELECT balance FROM balance_before)) * 100.0
       / (SELECT balance FROM balance_before) AS increase_rate
